channel.title: Pier & Point · Mariposa Park
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mariposa Park (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mariposa Park: OCII's plan lists Park P26 on lots 8723-003, 004, 006 and 007(p), on…
item.description: OCII's plan lists Park P26 on lots 8723-003, 004, 006 and 007(p), on the north side of Mariposa between Owens and 4th Streets, and Park P27 on lot 8723-002, at the northwest corner of Owens and Mariposa Streets. This outline is the union of lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006, so it is parcel P26, and a photo caption on OCII's Mission Bay South open-space page reads "P26 Mariposa Park". The page is renamed Mariposa Park (it was labelled P27) and the old address redirects. The shape, status and use are unchanged. Source: Successor Agency to the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency, Mission Bay North and South Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment A, page 11 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf), row 32 "Park P26 | North side of Mariposa between Owens and 4th Streets | 8723-003, 004, 006, 007(p) | 87,556" and row 33 "Park P27 | Northwest corner of Owens and Mariposa Streets | 8723-002 | 15,246"; OCII, Mission Bay South: Open Space (https://sfocii.org/projects/mission-bay-south/open-space), photo caption: "P26 Mariposa Park".

item.title: Correction · Mariposa Park: Potrero View reported in March 2016 that Mariposa Park would open…
item.description: Potrero View reported in March 2016 that Mariposa Park would open "this spring" (an expected date); no source read dates the actual opening. Source: https://www.potreroview.net/mariposa-park-set-to-open/ ; https://sfrecpark.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Mariposa-Park-451.

item.title: Correction · Mariposa Park: P27 no longer shows a 'complete, September 2026' date
item.description: P27 no longer shows a 'complete, September 2026' date. It rested only on Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery of an oval that is probably Mariposa Park (P26); no source says P27 was built. Source: Pier & Point editorial review.

item.title: Correction · Mariposa Park: P27 now uses its Assessor lot lines
item.description: P27 now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006.

item.title: Correction · Mariposa Park: A September 2026 accuracy check found that nothing supports labelling…
item.description: A September 2026 accuracy check found that nothing supports labelling the traced oval track as OCII parcel P27. It sits where Mariposa Park is (Potrero View, 2016-03-19, and SF Rec & Park's Mariposa Park page), OCII numbers Mariposa Park P26, and OCII's September 2023 deck lists P27 as not yet built. The record's name, map shape, status (complete) and 2026-09 milestone have not been changed; the identity question is noted on the record and remains open. The OCII deck's title no longer says 'CAC Item 2' (that came from its file name), and the aerial photo credit names only the Wikimedia Commons username Firstcultural. Source: Potrero View, 2016-03-19 (https://www.potreroview.net/mariposa-park-set-to-open/); SF Recreation and Park Department, Mariposa Park (https://sfrecpark.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Mariposa-Park-451); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).
